title: T-051 Daily Report Log Revision Scoping
description: Fixed the Daily Report Log popup (TaskDailyReportModal) showing a prior rejected revision's 100% on day-1 of a freshly-created revision. Frontend now filters reports by _revisionId to the current revision; backend getAllDailyReports dedup keyed by revision+date; task-list builders prefer authoritative currentRevision over stale revisionId; rejectTask stamps revisionId on subtask updates. ERR-091. tsc clean backend+frontend; behavioral verify pending on device.
